description: Project scaffolding, Electron setup, SQLite database with schema and seed data, and Dashboard screen. This establishes the entire project foundation including package.json, Electron main/preload processes, the complete database schema, Quran surah seed data, default levels, and the Dashboard UI with summary cards.
steps: Create package.json with project metadata, scripts (start, test, build), and dependencies: electron, better-sqlite3, exceljs, pdfkit, chart.js, dayjs, adm-zip. Dev dependencies: electron-builder, jest.

Create main.js - Electron main process: create BrowserWindow with appropriate size (1200x800), load src/renderer/index.html, handle app lifecycle events (ready, window-all-closed, activate). Enable nodeIntegration:false, contextIsolation:true, preload script.

Create preload.js - Expose IPC bridge via contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('api', {...}) for all database operations: getStudents, addStudent, updateStudent, archiveStudent, getLevels, addLevel, updateLevel, deleteLevel, getSurahs, getLevelSurahs, getProgress, updateProgress, getStats, exportExcel, exportPDF, exportBundle, importExcel, importBundle, backup, restore, getProfile, updateProfile, getStudentNotes, addStudentNote.
Create src/data/surahs.json - Complete list of all 114 Quran surahs with surah_no, name_ar (Arabic), name_en (English transliteration).

Create src/db/schema.js - Define and create all tables: profiles, levels, surahs, level_surahs, students, progress, student_notes, exports_history, imports_history. Use better-sqlite3 synchronous API. Include proper indexes.

Create src/db/seeds.js - Seed default levels (5 levels as specified), seed all 114 surahs from surahs.json, create level_surahs mappings (Level 1: An-Nas #114 to Az-Zalzalah #99, Level 2: Al-Bayyinah #98 to Al-A'la #87, Level 3: At-Tariq #86 to Al-Infitar #82, Level 4: At-Takwir #81 to An-Naba #78, Level 5: Al-Mursalat #77 and above meaning #1 to #77).
Create src/db/database.js - Database initialization: open/create SQLite file in app userData directory, run schema creation, run seeds if tables are empty, export db instance.
Create src/renderer/index.html - Main HTML shell with RTL direction, Arabic-first meta tags, viewport config, link to CSS, navigation sidebar, main content area with router placeholder, script tags.

Create src/renderer/css/main.css - Complete design system: CSS custom properties for design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows), status color system (NOT_STARTED=red, IN_PROGRESS=blue, MEMORIZED=green, REVIEW_REQUIRED=yellow, WEAK=orange, PERFECT=dark-green), RTL layout, responsive grid, sidebar navigation styles, card components, table styles, form styles, button styles, modal styles, badge/chip styles for status indicators.
Create src/renderer/css/dashboard.css - Dashboard-specific styles: summary cards grid, quick actions section, recent updates list.

Create src/renderer/js/app.js - Main application router: handle navigation between screens (dashboard, students, levels, surahs, student-profile, progress-matrix, reports, import-export, backup, settings). Render active screen, manage sidebar active states.

Create src/renderer/js/screens/dashboard.js - Dashboard screen: fetch stats via window.api (total students, total levels, surahs count, weak students count, review-required count), render summary cards with icons, render recent updates list, render quick action buttons (Add Student, View Progress, Export Report).
Wire up IPC handlers in main.js for database operations: register ipcMain.handle() for each API method, connect to database.js service layer.
Create src/services/stats.js - Statistics service: getOverallStats(), getRecentUpdates(), getWeakStudents(), getReviewRequiredStudents().
Add basic Jest test configuration in jest.config.js and create tests/db/schema.test.js to verify database schema creation and seeding works correctly.
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes - database schema and seeds tests verify tables are created and seed data is inserted correctly
The Electron app can be launched (npm start) and shows the Dashboard screen with RTL Arabic layout
Dashboard displays summary cards with correct stats (0 students initially, 5 levels, 114 surahs)
Navigation sidebar allows switching between screen placeholders
SQLite database is created in the app's userData directory with all tables and seed data
verification: Run `npm install` and confirm exit code 0
Run `npm test` and confirm all tests pass
Run `npx electron --no-sandbox --headless . &` briefly to confirm the app initializes without crashes (check stderr for errors)
findings: All 20 Jest tests pass. npm install succeeds. Electron cannot be visually launched due to missing system libraries (libnss3.so) which is expected in this headless environment. Node.js database code verified working independently. better-sqlite3 native module compiles and works correctly on this system.
